summary: Iteration 104 - Event Intelligence Integration with Dynamic Pricing Testing Complete. Frontend UI fully functional with Event Intelligence as sub-tab in Market Robot. Dynamic Pricing shows event column with MEGA/LARGE badges and event factor in breakdown.
